target: The tubercles (calluses) on the inner tepals (valves) of the fruiting perianth are absent. In Rumex these are tepals PO:0009033, not sepals. PO tubercle PO:0025352 is the cactus podarium and does not fit, so there is no term: hold the absence back. The valves are present (apex obtuse).

target: The receptacular (floral) bracts inside the capitulum are absent. The involucral bracts, bract PO:0009055, are present (as long as the leaves). Keep 'receptacular' or 'involucral' as context.
fix: In Eriocaulaceae and Asteraceae, 'receptacular bracts' (paleae, floral bracts) and 'involucral bracts' are different sets of bracts. The absence of one never removes the other. Keep the qualifier as context.

target: Nothing is absent. 'never palmate' is a negated arrangement (the spikes are not digitately arranged). Hold it back, as with other negated qualities. The spike inflorescence PO:0030117 is present (linear).

target: domatium FLOPO:0986021 absent PATO:0000462. Leaf lamina PO:0020039 is present (apex acute).

target: leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent PATO:0000462 (here on the bamboo culm or leaf sheath), and the oral cilia (setae at the sheath mouth; no term) are absent. 'apex truncate' belongs to the sheath or ligule PO:0020105, not to a stipule.

target: bulbil FLOPO:0986055 absent PATO:0000462 in the axils of the distal leaves. The leaves, vascular leaf PO:0009025, are present (base cordate).

target: The ultimate branchlets of the cyme are sterile and spinelike, with no flowers. Flowers PO:0009046 are present on the other branches. Use the sterile branchlet as context; do not record 'flower absent'.

target: No annotation: 'not seen' means the material was not available. Also, 'Infructescences congested-cymose' belongs to infructescence PO:0006342 congested PATO:0001836, not inflorescence.
